reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking Al content to γ′ formation and improved properties via well-established mechanisms, though it slightly overstates the direct role of Al in lattice distortion and ordering without acknowledging the complex interplay of other elements.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and comprehensive, with a well-defined falsification criterion, but the practical feasibility of conducting all proposed tests (radiation, cryogenic, oxidation) on a single sample series is challenging and may require separate optimized experiments.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful as it proposes a specific, testable microstructural mechanism (γ′ precipitation) to simultaneously address multiple critical properties, directly guiding alloy design for this widely studied HEA system.
